Coefficient comparison over continuously varying k rigorously characterizes every neutral pi, including zero supports. The paired discounted survival success has a cosh ratio with strictly positive logarithmic derivative for k>theta. A renewal identity gives E_i T=(1-s_i)/(gamma S_pi), guaranteeing strict simultaneous optimality from each starting state; asymptotics follow from cosh expansions. The actual packaged checker independently tests exact rational Markov solves and numerical hyperbolic identities (3666 assertions). Only the analytic argument proves the all-parameter assertion.

value.rationale: Equal reset-neutral absorption probabilities can hide dramatic differences in mean time to either boundary. The theorem finds the unique physically meaningful fastest spatial relocation policy over a naturally constrained, completely classified family for every finite lattice length, step bias, and fixed reset frequency. The divergent midpoint versus bounded edge-start clock comparison makes the distinction quantitatively substantive and useful for controlling transport with fixed splitting.
